# The tools Supabase's MCP server defines in packages/mcp-server-supabase/src/tools of supabase-community/supabase-mcp at commit
# bd2d33f1b401adbbf913b3f40eb460fd67e1f9ea, which supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/mcp documents for mcp.supabase.com, one per line.
# Storage and notebooks are off unless asked for. execute_sql marks itself read only when the server runs read only, and changes data otherwise.
# Each line is a tool as its server names it and whether it only reads or changes something.
list_edge_functions read
get_edge_function read
deploy_edge_function change
get_logs read
query_logs read
get_advisors read
list_organizations read
get_organization read
list_projects read
get_project read
get_cost read
confirm_cost read
create_project change
pause_project change
restore_project change
get_project_url read
get_publishable_keys read
generate_typescript_types read
list_tables read
list_extensions read
list_migrations read
apply_migration change
execute_sql change
create_edge_function_secret change
create_branch change
list_branches read
delete_branch change
merge_branch change
reset_branch change
rebase_branch change
list_storage_buckets read
get_storage_config read
update_storage_config change
search_docs read
list_notebooks read
get_notebook read
